title: Dental hygienist assistant: rinse, clear the mouth and return both tools
instruction: Rinse the highlighted teeth, lift the rinsing tool while suction clears the mouth, then return and release both tools on their stands.
context: Dental hygienists and dental assistants routinely coordinate rinsing and evacuation during professional cleaning. This inert training task measures wet crown coverage, local water removal and tool return; it does not simulate polishing or clinical treatment. Affordable standard pumps, tubing, cameras and a supplied printable fixture are specified in EQUIPMENT.md; estimated bench cost GBP 180-240 excluding robot/computer/existing cameras.
setup: Rigid printed PETG dental-training fixture, base170x130x12 mm; three target crowns diameter20 mm at(235/270/305,25,37) mm, three connected28x18 mm floor cells atz31. Two75 g tools with28x24x55 mm handles and stock hollow tubing OD5/ID3 mm for irrigation, OD9/ID7 mm for evacuation. Stands diameter50,height30 at(280,+200)/(280,-200) mm. Two Adafruit1150 12 V peristaltic pumps, silicone hoses, Nano Every timer, open recovery cup and spill tray; no clinical suction plant. EQUIPMENT.md supplies bill of materials, build/calibration steps and printable CAD; PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md gives all geometry and numerical measurements. Layout matches existing simulation media; physical assembly is untested.
scoring: Any guard failure, spill>0.30 mL, whole-trial peak mouth water>1.00 mL, final mouth water>0.50 mL, or recovery<90% supplied gives0. Otherwise0.25 per tooth with>=1.8 mL delivery and>=0.15 s wet dwell in all9 crown regions, up to0.75. Full1.0 additionally requires final mouth water<=0.05 mL; after the final pulse the irrigator tip must be above80 mm while suction remains in the declared mouth-floor region>=1 s until cleared. Both tools must then return to their original stands within10 mm XY,5 mm Z and10 degrees orientation, speed<20 mm/s, with every fingertip>65 mm from both handle references. Hold the returned-and-released endpoint1 s. Pump0.4 mL/s at16-21,24-29,32-37 s; all water and temporal checks use actual model state. PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md specifies physical measurement and uncertainty. Raw score1.0 is withheld until the continuous1 s endpoint hold completes; earlier full-quality endpoints receive0.75.
reset_notes: Fixed initial layout, seed1, zero jitter. Reset tool poses, water inventories, peak/loss/guard history, cleanup timer and cleanup-complete flag. Both tools initially sit released on their own stands; this cannot satisfy post-rinse cleanup.
fidelity: Rigid enlarged inert phantom; conservative runoff/pool model, not CFD. Affordable physical build uses printed PETG, stock tubing and two peristaltic pumps; it is untested. No saliva, swallowing, airway, aerosols, soft tissue or clinical safety claim. Pump pulsation, wetting, hose forces, near-dry pickup and water metrology need bench validation. Existing media remain simulation evidence.
